512-1355-7014.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-7014.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

252-4231-5394-7060.easyPrerequisites:

You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7060.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-4661-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.

Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-4871-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1563-3899-4742-4772.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.

1020-1976-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Etherium Sculptor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Etherium Sculptor.
Repeat.

When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4766-5229-5231-7091.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ulamog, adding {R}.
When Ulamog dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ulamog trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Ulamog and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4766-5229-5231-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Ulamog or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Ulamog with the returned creature for that iteration.

57-1849-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-1849-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

277-907-5702-6850.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

3480-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-2921-5401.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Activate Marvin using Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.

Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {1}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.

1183-1365-1651-2034.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1183-1365-1651-2034.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Pentavus persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pentavus, adding {C}{C}.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pentavus' first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Pentavus and a Pentavite, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana and Pentavite tokens, you may use Pentavus' second ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

Cast Sunbeam Spellbomb from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Ash Zealot triggers, dealing 3 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, drawing three cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Emry.
Activate Mind Over Matter two more times by discarding two cards, untapping two lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add {1}{W}.
Activate either of Sunbeam Spellbomb's abilities by paying {W} and sacrificing it, either gaining 5 life or drawing a card.
Repeat.

1636-1936-2204-4050.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster, adding one mana of any color.
Kithkin Spellduster dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Kithkin Spellduster enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Kithkin Spellduster, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1102-1636-3263-4186.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
